name: Isekai'd into the arms of a Yandere Duke
source:
The story follows the player, who awakens in a world different from the one they know, and yet is familiar. They come face to face with their favorite character from an old medieval fantasy otome game (tentatively named Rosalind's Lie) - The Duke Lucien 'Lucy' Lockhart, who had gained self-awareness after the many, many replays the player has gone through his route seeking comfort.

The player's memories of ending up in this situation are fuzzy, but they are very much in the world of the otome game, made reality. While they try to find their bearings in this new place, they have to juggle with the Duke's clear affections for them while figuring out whether they want to stay, or if they want to go back home, at the risk of setting off the man who has something to do with their mysterious arrival in the first place.

[From [url=https://selfindulgentfiction.itch.io/isekaid-into-the-arms-of-a-yandere-duke]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述玩家在一个与他们所熟悉的世界不同但又熟悉的世界中醒来的故事。他们与来自古老的中世纪幻想乙女游戏（暂定名为罗莎琳德的谎言）中最喜欢的角色——卢西恩“露西”洛克哈特公爵面对面，在玩家多次重玩寻求安慰的路线后，他获得了自我意识。

玩家对这种情况的记忆是模糊的，但他们在乙女游戏的世界中，已经成为现实。当他们试图在这个新地方找到自己的方位时，他们必须权衡公爵对他们明显的感情，同时弄清楚他们是想留下来，还是想回家，冒着引爆与他们的神秘到来有关的男人的风险。

[来自[url=https://selfindulgentfiction.itch.io/isekaid-into-the-arms-of-a-yandere-duke]Itch.io[/url]]
